values.meaning: Tentacle slam physical damage to enemies struck
values.binNote: IllaoiQ#TentacleDamageTotal = (byLevel(9..180) + TotalADRatio(1.1)xad + APRatio(0.4)xap) * 1 + TentacleDamageAmp[rank]; the by-level base literal 9..180 is embedded inline in the calculation string and is not exposed as its own named DataValue, so it cannot be cited as a bin row on its own - only the named DataValues TotalADRatio, APRatio and TentacleDamageAmp are addressable rows, and the wiki reports TentacleDamageAmp separately as a rank-based percent increase in the description text rather than folding it into the base 9-to-180 number, matching the wiki's presentation used here.

values.meaning: Percent increase to Tentacle slam damage from Tentacle Smash rank
values.quote: increased by {{pp|0;10 to 30|0 to 5 for 6|key=%|formula=100% + 10% at rank 1, then 5% per rank|type = [[File:Tentacle Smash.png|20px|link=]] Tentacle Smash's rank}}

values.meaning: Per-slam damage reduction on a target hit repeatedly within a short window, capped
values.quote: Each enemy individually reduces the slam damage by 50% for every slam they were hit by in the last {{fd|0.66}} seconds, capped at 75% less damage.
values.binNote: No corresponding IllaoiQ/IllaoiPassive data value carries this 50%/75%/0.66s stacking-reduction mechanic; it appears to be tooltip/hardcoded logic not exposed as a bin data value.

values.meaning: Illaoi is healed for a percent of her missing health when a Tentacle hits at least one enemy champion

mechanics.claim: A Tentacle's slam is an area-of-effect instance dealing damage to all enemies struck simultaneously, not a single-target hit.
mechanics.quote: dealing {{as|{{pplevel|9 to 180}} {{as|(+ 110% AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}} physical damage|physical damage}} to all enemies struck

mechanics.claim: Repeated slams on the same target within 0.66 seconds stack a damage reduction on that hit, up to a 75% cap, lowering the damage the tentacle deals to a heavily-hit target.
mechanics.quote: Each enemy individually reduces the slam damage by 50% for every slam they were hit by in the last {{fd|0.66}} seconds, capped at 75% less damage.

mechanics.claim: Tentacles attack only when commanded by Illaoi's abilities; they do not attack on their own.
The missing-health heal from a Tentacle hit only triggers if it hits at least one enemy champion (not on non-champion targets), and is a self-heal that does not change damage dealt.
mechanics.quote: '''Illaoi''' for {{as|5% of her '''missing''' health}} if it hits at least one enemy {{tip|champion}}

mechanics.claim: The Tentacle heal is applied after omnivamp is calculated.
When multiple Tentacles hit simultaneously, the resulting heal is computed iteratively off updated missing health rather than as one flat sum, per hit count n.
mechanics.quote: the received healing is calculated iteratively based on the new amount of '''missing''' health, as per this formula: {{as|('''maximum''' health{{minus}}'''current''' health)}}{{times}}(1{{minus}}0.95<sup>n</sup>), with 'n' the number of {{as|Tentacle|buzzword2}} hits.

mechanics.claim: Newly spawned Tentacles are untargetable for 2 seconds before they can attack.
mechanics.quote: Tentacles fully spawn after a 2 second delay and are {{tip|untargetable}} in the meantime.
